description: VYBE Music v4.2.0 - YouTube Playlist Import & Refresh Persistence Fix, Real Phone Stream Playback Fix, Listen Together Host/Guest Sync Fix, and Battery Optimization.

announcement.title: Welcome To VYBE Music v4.2.0
announcement.message: Welcome to VYBE Music v4.2.0! Fixed playlist imports vanishing on refresh, stream playback on mobile carrier networks, Listen Together pause synchronization, and extensive battery life optimizations.

changelog.title: Playlist Import & Persistence Fixes
items: Fixed Disappearing Playlists: Local & imported playlists are now permanently bookmarked and protected from being wiped or hidden on library refresh or account sync
Complete Pagination: YouTube playlists import all tracks across pages with zero missing songs and full dynamic mix/radio support

changelog.title: Real Phone Stream Playback
items: Fixed Mobile Network 403 Forbidden: Corrected User-Agent matching and added range probe fallback so streams play reliably on real phones and cellular networks (Jio, Airtel, etc.)
Fallback Stream Resolution: Seamless fallback to high-compatibility stream formats if direct probe is restricted

changelog.title: Listen Together Synchronized Playback
items: Instant Pause on Guest Phones: When the host pauses, stops, or changes songs, guest devices immediately pause instead of continuing to play
Track End Handling: End-of-track and player clearing are synchronized across all connected listeners

changelog.title: Battery Usage Optimization
items: Background Widget Optimization: Disabled 1-second background refresh loop when no home screen widgets are active
Optimized WiFi & Wake Locks: Reduced network locks and minimized UI polling frequency during playback to drastically reduce battery drain

changelog.title: Listening Stats in Library
items: Replaced Recap: Display total listening hours and days since the app was installed right in your library
Quick Access to Insights: Tap the listening stats button to jump straight into detailed stats and history
